title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters because it enables Yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing for more robust API development. It will parse incoming request bodies and make the data available to route handlers. This improves performance by reducing the need for manual parsing in user code.
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request bodies are correctly parsed and made available to route handlers, with proper error handling for invalid or unsupported request bodies.
reason: This feature is a key requirement for building robust APIs, and its implementation aligns with Yantraverse's goal of providing a lightweight yet fully-featured Node.js framework.
